decision.claim_boundary: A development pass establishes only that the already-implemented cross-ply frame statistic detects frozen adjacent-winding half-slab substitutions more often than it falsely flags the intact w035 seam on these ten development regions. It does not prove arbitrary sheet identity, recto completeness, reconstruction correctness, ink, readability, or Grand Prize eligibility.
